title: All 15 scenarios passed — VLM-primary scene graph + stable object identity
summary: All 15 CI scenarios passed (15/15, 100%). The PR introduces a VLM-primary scene graph where an image-grounded VLM call owns relational/semantic edges, while a fast geometric loop (3 Hz) handles only reachable_by. Object identity is stabilized via cross-tick re-bind, soft eviction with TTL, and new merge passes (same-class proximity, cross-class geometric collapse, configurable class groups). The pilot's RTDL parser now tolerates prose preamble around JSON. The scene-graph LLM enrichment ran but all VLM calls to the fake-vlm endpoint returned empty JSON, so no semantic edges were produced; the geometric loop and object registry functioned correctly.

system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/relations.py: Added _normalize_relation, infer_semantic_relation, increased LLM timeout to 60s.
system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/store.py: Split into geometric and semantic slices; added geometry-signature-based cache key, prune_relations, and compose get_snapshot.
system/scene/scene_service/scene_graph/types.py: Added reachable_by to RELATION_TYPES, geometric method to SceneGraphEdge.
system/scene/scene_service/service.py: Replaced RelationEngine with GeometricRelationLoop; wired scene-graph store and perception into builder.

system/scene/scene_service/web.py: Removed on-canvas edge drawing; added explicit relation list in info panel.
system/scene/scripts/start.sh: Added env passthrough for new scene-graph knobs.
system/scene/tests/test_identity.py: New file — unit tests for find_rebindable, soft_evict, prune_expired, parse_merge_class_groups, cross-tick re-bind, TTL prune.
system/scene/tests/test_image_relations.py: New file — unit tests for projection, parsing, annotation, multimodal body, builder dispatch, transient-blip guard.
system/scene/tests/test_persistence.py: Added _object_ttl_s and _merge_class_group to detector stub.

system/scene/tests/test_scene_graph.py: Added tests for geometric_relation, compute_geometric_edges, geometry_signature, cache invalidation, store compose, debounce, infer_semantic_relation, normalize_relation, reasoning_effort, prune_relations.
test_result: 15 scenarios across builtin, cap, and flow families all passed. Builtin tests exercised file I/O, plan control, and command execution. Cap tests exercised camera/lidar snapshots, explore (timeout), map save, memory roundtrip, scene object listing, speech, and voiceprint. Flow tests exercised fault recovery (memory save), object navigation (explore → list objects → goal_near → navigate), and patrol observe (parallel camera/lidar → memory save → search). The scene-graph LLM enrichment ran but all VLM calls to the fake-vlm endpoint returned empty JSON, so no semantic edges were produced; the geometric loop and object registry functioned correctly.

evidence.text: 07-05 12:53:21.820  W scene                    [scene-graph-llm] request failed: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)

suggested_fix: No fix needed. The fake-vlm endpoint returns empty JSON, which is expected in CI without real VLM credentials. The scene-graph LLM enrichment correctly degrades to no semantic edges. If real VLM inference is desired, set VLM_BASE_URL/VLM_API_KEY/VLM_MODEL to a working endpoint.
risks_or_watchouts: Scene-graph LLM enrichment produced no semantic edges because the fake-vlm endpoint returns empty JSON; this is expected in CI but means the VLM-primary path is untested end-to-end.
Object memory persistence failed (No module named 'pymilvus'), so warm-restore across restarts is disabled; this does not affect the current test run.

The explore skill's first attempt (5s timeout) waited for map→base_link tf and timed out without moving; the second attempt (8s timeout) successfully drove to a frontier and swept, then timed out. This is expected behavior for a bounded exploration test.
The scene-graph builder's transient-blip guard preserved edges when all objects went missing, but since no edges were ever produced, this path was not exercised.
